name: get_property
description: Read one or more devices' current property values (status, temperature, brightness, etc.) in a single call. Put every device+property pair you need this turn into this one call's `properties` list -- never split them across separate calls.

properties.description: One entry per device+property you want read. Each entry is fully independent.

device_id.description: The device's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE -- never guessed.

property.description: The property's exact display name, exactly as shown for this device in DEVICE DATABASE -- not an id. Or the wildcard "*" to read every property this device currently reports, skipping name resolution for this entry.
